name: Flare
description_en: A nonbloated, modern, and highly configurable file/screenshot vault server with support for ShareX, Flameshot, and Spectacle. Offers OCR search and more. `MIT` `Docker/Nodejs`
description: A modern, lightning-fast file sharing platform built for self-hosting. Created with support for ShareX, KDE Spectacle, Flameshot, and easy to set up.
readme_preview:
Icon designed by xNefas
